headline: Superior National Forest and Resort Access Protocols
reservation: Daily vehicle permits are required for Minnesota State Parks like Temperance River; Lutsen Mountains lift tickets and gondola rides require separate seasonal bookings. Official checks of the Superior Hiking Trail Association site are recommended for trail status.

days.title: Sawtooth Mountain Summits

stops.name: Moose Mountain Gondola
stops.detail: Take the scenic tram to the summit for panoramic views of Lake Superior and the boreal forest canopy.

stops.name: Oberg Mountain Loop
stops.detail: Hike the Superior Hiking Trail segment for multiple overlooks of Oberg Lake and the rolling Sawtooth range.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; gravel forest roads require cautious speeds
days.note: The gondola operation is weather-dependent; check resort status for wind closures.

days.title: North Shore Cascades and Canyons

stops.name: Temperance River State Park
stops.detail: View the dramatic potholes and deep river gorges carved into ancient volcanic rock.

stops.name: Ray Berglund State Wayside
stops.detail: Access the mouth of the Onion River for agate hunting on the basalt pebble beaches of Lake Superior.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; conditions vary on Highway 61
days.note: Waterfall volume peaks during the spring thaw, typically in late April and May.

days.title: Boreal Forest and Maritime History

stops.name: North Shore Commercial Fishing Museum
stops.detail: Learn about the Scandinavian pioneers and the history of commercial fishing in Tofte.

stops.name: Caribou Lake
stops.detail: Drive inland for a quiet look at the freshwater lakes of the Superior National Forest.

days.driving: Allow 1.5 hours; conditions vary with forest road maintenance
days.note: Inland forest roads may be impassable in early spring due to mud; check local conditions.

intel.title: State Park Permits
intel.text: Daily or annual Minnesota State Park permits must be displayed at Temperance River. Trailhead parking at Oberg Mountain fills quickly on autumn weekends.

intel.title: Wilderness Connectivity
intel.text: Signal is generally reliable along Highway 61 but drops significantly once you travel inland toward the Superior Hiking Trail. Offline maps are essential.

intel.title: Highway 61 Services
intel.text: Fuel is available in Tofte and Grand Marais. Ensure a full tank before exploring remote forest roads inland from the lake.

intel.title: Fall Foliage Peak
intel.text: Peak colors typically occur late September to early October. Mid-week visits are suggested to avoid heavy leaf-peeping traffic.

intel.title: Trail Conditions
intel.text: Spring 'mud season' can lead to temporary trail closures to prevent erosion. Check the Superior Hiking Trail Association for current status.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at DLH for the 2.5-hour drive north; stop in Duluth for major supplies as local options in Lutsen are limited.
plan.vehicle: All-wheel drive is suggested for winter visits; standard vehicles are fine for Highway 61 in summer. Check rental rules for forest roads.
plan.goldenHour: Oberg Mountain Overlook for sunrise over Lake Superior, with visibility subject to morning lake mist.
